A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UNITE study. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices support comparison, including matching content relocated in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, model-compatibility experiments, ablations, latency measurements, and qualitative cases.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds BBH, CMMLU, prompt-formatting, and extended hyperparameter experiments in the appendix.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same model-selection criteria, top-k union construction, tokenization alignment, probability aggregation, and greedy decoding. The additional prompt-formatting experiment does not revise the proposed ensemble algorithm.

E1.justification: Appendices A.2–A.3 add evaluation on ten selected BBH subsets and Chinese CMMLU, substantially extending task and language coverage beyond the original six benchmarks. The original benchmarks remain.

E2.justification: Table 9 introduces Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as a standalone comparator in the new TriviaQA experiment. The existing ensemble comparison methods remain LLM-BLENDER, DEEPEN, and GAC; their extension to BBH and CMMLU adds no new ensemble baseline algorithm.

E3.justification: Existing experimental settings remain unchanged. New appendix protocols include a revised five-shot answer-format template for LLaMA3/Qwen2.5, ten randomly selected BBH subsets, and larger tested k values. The new TriviaQA comparison uses 100 manually scored examples for the original prompt versus the full 1,500-example set after reformatting.

E4.justification: Appendix A.1 adds a prompt-format intervention examining response-style compatibility. Appendix A.4 extends the existing k sensitivity analysis from values up to 30 to 100, 1,000, and 10,000. Existing decoding, efficiency, and qualitative analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Parenthesized values in v2 Table 9 are original-prompt accuracies, not uncertainty estimates; the added sampling information concerns evaluation design.

E6.justification: The original results remain, but v2 substantially expands reported outcomes. UNITE scores 73.52 on BBH and 83.89 on CMMLU, versus best individual-model scores of 73.00 and 83.22. Reformatted TriviaQA yields 67.45 for UNITE, 64.77 for LLM-BLENDER, and 70.68 for LLaMA3. Table 12 adds large-k results, including 65.72 at k=10,000. These are additional experimental conditions, not improvements over corresponding v1 scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation of token alignment, normalization, and probability averaging is unchanged. v2 adds no formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or substantive derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central claims about model compatibility, model selection, and efficient top-k union ensembling. Additional appendix evidence supports these existing claims without redefining the main contributions.

C2.justification: Appendix A.1 newly discusses standardized answer formatting as a response-style remedy while retaining the performance-gap limitation. Appendix A.3 extends the vocabulary-size interpretation to Chinese, and A.2 acknowledges that computational and time constraints restricted BBH evaluation to ten subsets.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and repository address to the abstract. The appendix supplies an example reformatted prompt and describes manual prediction extraction. The original hardware disclosure and default k remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to Suzgun et al. (2022) for BBH and Li et al. (2024) for CMMLU. The related-work discussion and positioning against existing ensemble approaches remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The main narrative is largely verbatim. Changes include updated affiliations and conference headers, acknowledgements, additional appendix subsections, and moving the existing case-study subsection from A.2 to A.5. There is no extensive rewriting or structural overhaul.

P2.justification: v2 adds appendix Tables 8–12 and retains the original GSM8K case table as Table 13. All six original plots retain their content, while some figures move, captions for Figures 4 and 6 expand, and conference headers produce layout reflow.

improvement.justification: The Chinese and BBH evaluations broaden empirical support, while the extended k analysis strengthens evidence for restricting token candidates. Prompt examples and code-access information also improve documentation. These gains are limited by unspecified BBH subset identities and the unequal samples used in the original-versus-reformatted TriviaQA comparison, which prevents a clean attribution of accuracy changes to prompting.
